mapper.update: UPDATE ifj_concurrency_permit permit SET owner_instance_id = instance_record.id, owner_root_instance_id = instance_record.root_instance_id, owner_trigger_id = instance_record.trigger_id, lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, permit_token = #{permitToken}, permit_fence = permit.permit_fence + 1, execution_fence = #{executionFence}, lease_deadline = (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) + (#{leaseMicros} * INTERVAL '1 microsecond')), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM ifj_instance instance_record, ifj_trigger_work_item work_item WHERE instance_record.id = #{instanceId} AND work_item.trigger_id = instance_record.trigger_id AND permit.scope_key = #{scopeKey} AND permit.slot_no = #{slotNo} AND permit.permit_fence < 9223372036854775807 AND (permit.owner_instance_id IS NULL OR permit.lease_deadline <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND instance_record.root_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND instance_record.execution_fence = #{executionFence} AND instance_record.status IN ('WAITING', 'RUNNING') AND work_item.status = 'CLAIMED' AND work_item.claim_token = #{claimToken} AND work_item.fence_token = #{executionFence} AND work_item.lease_deadline > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)

UPDATE ifj_concurrency_permit AS permit SET owner_instance_id = instance_record.id, owner_root_instance_id = instance_record.root_instance_id, owner_trigger_id = instance_record.trigger_id, lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, permit_token = #{permitToken}, permit_fence = permit.permit_fence + 1, execution_fence = #{executionFence}, lease_deadline = strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now', printf('+%.6f seconds', (#{leaseMicros} / 1000000.0))), update_time = strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now') FROM ifj_instance instance_record, ifj_trigger_work_item work_item WHERE instance_record.id = #{instanceId} AND work_item.trigger_id = instance_record.trigger_id AND permit.scope_key = #{scopeKey} AND permit.slot_no = #{slotNo} AND permit.permit_fence < 9223372036854775807 AND (permit.owner_instance_id IS NULL OR permit.lease_deadline <= strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now')) AND instance_record.root_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND instance_record.execution_fence = #{executionFence} AND instance_record.status IN ('WAITING', 'RUNNING') AND work_item.status = 'CLAIMED' AND work_item.claim_token = #{claimToken} AND work_item.fence_token = #{executionFence} AND work_item.lease_deadline > strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now')

MERGE INTO ifj_concurrency_permit permit USING ( SELECT permit.ROWID AS target_rowid, instance_record.id AS source_value_0, instance_record.root_instance_id AS source_value_1, instance_record.trigger_id AS source_value_2 FROM ifj_concurrency_permit permit, ifj_instance instance_record, ifj_trigger_work_item work_item WHERE instance_record.id = #{instanceId} AND work_item.trigger_id = instance_record.trigger_id AND permit.scope_key = #{scopeKey} AND permit.slot_no = #{slotNo} AND permit.permit_fence < 9223372036854775807 AND (permit.owner_instance_id IS NULL OR permit.lease_deadline <= CAST(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP(3))) AND instance_record.root_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND instance_record.execution_fence = #{executionFence} AND instance_record.status IN ('WAITING', 'RUNNING') AND work_item.status = 'CLAIMED' AND work_item.claim_token = #{claimToken} AND work_item.fence_token = #{executionFence} AND work_item.lease_deadline > CAST(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP(3)) ) source ON (permit.ROWID = source.target_rowid) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET owner_instance_id = source.source_value_0, owner_root_instance_id = source.source_value_1, owner_trigger_id = source.source_value_2, lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, permit_token = #{permitToken}, permit_fence = permit.permit_fence + 1, execution_fence = #{executionFence}, lease_deadline = CAST(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP(3)) + NUMTODSINTERVAL(#{leaseMicros} / 1000000, 'SECOND'), update_time = CAST(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP(3))

UPDATE permit SET owner_instance_id = instance_record.id, owner_root_instance_id = instance_record.root_instance_id, owner_trigger_id = instance_record.trigger_id, lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, permit_token = #{permitToken}, permit_fence = permit.permit_fence + 1, execution_fence = #{executionFence}, lease_deadline = DATEADD(MILLISECOND, (#{leaseMicros} / 1000), SYSUTCDATETIME()), update_time = SYSUTCDATETIME() FROM ifj_concurrency_permit AS permit, ifj_instance instance_record, ifj_trigger_work_item work_item WHERE instance_record.id = #{instanceId} AND work_item.trigger_id = instance_record.trigger_id AND permit.scope_key = #{scopeKey} AND permit.slot_no = #{slotNo} AND permit.permit_fence < 9223372036854775807 AND (permit.owner_instance_id IS NULL OR permit.lease_deadline <= SYSUTCDATETIME()) AND instance_record.root_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND instance_record.execution_fence = #{executionFence} AND instance_record.status IN ('WAITING', 'RUNNING') AND work_item.status = 'CLAIMED' AND work_item.claim_token = #{claimToken} AND work_item.fence_token = #{executionFence} AND work_item.lease_deadline > SYSUTCDATETIME()
